_comment: Accounts whose User MTM id differs from their All User (Main) id.
The All User sheet lists CC04 as a running INT account on VS7, but the
User MTM writes that same account as XLDH142 — and XLDH142 also exists in
the All User sheet as a dropped DLR ACC row. Without this map the account
cannot be classified and lands in the Unclassified section.
The alias column CANNOT be parsed for this: CC03, CC10 and CC11 carry no
trace of their MTM id (A19_CC03, CC_A8_CC10_4C, A27_MTPRO), so the
mapping has to be stated explicitly here.
Ids are matched case-insensitively and leading zeros are ignored, so the
purely numeric entries below are already handled by that rule and are
listed only to document the known cases — they are harmless no-ops.
Add a new account by adding one line. No code change, no redeploy.
This file is optional: if it is missing, the map is simply empty.
